task: Fix consecutive real Raspberry Pi 3 early-boot faults before paging activation
acceptanceCriteria: platform initialization performs no exclusive atomic operation before MMU activation
MTE capability logging uses the Raspberry Pi mini-UART instead of the QEMU PL011
board-rpi3 kernel emits its normal boot banner on real hardware at 115200 baud
RPi3 image generation packages a raw AArch64 kernel rather than an ELF file
publicContracts: platform::init must complete before platform::with and paging initialization
kernel8.img must be a raw AArch64 image loaded at 0x80000
blastRadius: AArch64 and RV64 early platform discovery
AArch64 CFI and MTE early-hardening initialization

scoutSummary: The platform Spinlock fault is fixed on real hardware. The next reproducible stop occurs after both CFI lines when mte::init logs through QEMU PL011 0x09000000 on board-rpi3; the prior ID-register read already succeeded, isolating the invalid UART MMIO access.
